Name: (MOVED) (SEE DESCRIPTION) Vaels Familiars - An NPC Shop Expansion
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][b][i][u]﻿[b][i][u][size=5]﻿VAEL AND THEIR FAMILIARS HAVE MOVED! [/size]
[size=5]YOU CAN NOW FIND THE UPDATED VERSIONS AT[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45040][size=5]TALES OF THE AETHER GLADE![/size][/url]
[size=2]and yuzuki dont worry shes not going anywhere :)[/size]
[/u][/i][/b][/u][/i][/b][/center]
[center]
[size=4][b][i][u]Installation and Mod Requirements
[/u][/i][/b][/size]This mod requires:

 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167]﻿﻿Bog's Tilesheets[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997?tab=description]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073?tab=description]TrinketTinker
[/url]﻿﻿
﻿[b]Trinket Tinker[/b] is required for familiars to provide buffs and abilities.
If you [i]only[/i] want familiars as cosmetic pets, this requirement may be optional.
[b]SVE[/b] is NO LONGER A REQUIREMENT! But it should still be compatible :)

Like any other mod, all you gotta do is download the file and drop it into your mods folder.  

[b][i][u][size=4]So, what's in this thing?[/size]
[/u][/i][/b][/center]
[center][b][i][u][size=5]New NPC: Vael[/size][/u][/i][/b][/center]
[center]
Vael is a fully custom, romanceable NPC with a complete storyline.
An ancient shepherd of spirits and keeper of the pack, Vael runs a small shop in the lower-right area of the forest, offering potions and magical companions.
They may just have a little more going on to them too, for those willing to dig deeper!
[i]Features include:[/i]
Multiple heart events
A full romance and marriage path
Unique marriage content and post-marriage dialogue
A slow-burn narrative focused on trust, choice, and companionship
Vael becomes available after reaching [b]2 hearts with the Wizard[/b]

[b][i][u][size=5]New NPC: Yuzuki[/size][/u][/i][/b]
Yuzuki is a fully custom Child NPC with a complete storyline.
A lost spirit longing for a body, she needs your help to stabilize her form in this world before she disappears!
She's softspoken and genuine, contrasting with Vaels more serious tone.
[i]Features include:[/i]
Multiple heart events
Ritual events to retain her physical form
and more to come in the future!
Yuzuki becomes available after reaching [b]2 hearts with Vael and completing their Quest[/b]


[size=5][b][i][u]New Mechanic: Familiars[/u][/i][/b][/size]
﻿Familiars are magical companions integrated with Stardew’s pet system.
Once you:
Reach [b]full friendship with your first pet[/b], [i]or
[/i]Enter [b]Year 2 without adopting a pet[/b],
…you’ll gain access to Vael’s Familiar shop.

[i][u]Currently implemented:[/u][/i]
[b]The Spirit Hound[/b]
A loyal pup, provides an attack buff to the player and passively attacks hostile mobs.
[b]The Watcher Crow[/b]
A keen-eyed companion that automatically shakes trees and gathers forage as you explore.
[b]The Moonlit Otter
[/b]Suspected to be related in some way to the Moonlit Jellies, this playful otter automatically catches fish for you in certain areas.[/center]
[center][b]The Aether Squirrel
[/b]Said to plant the seeds of the Aether Tree, these resourceful squirrel will harvest crops and till Dig Spots for you.[/center]
[center][b]The Dream Sheep[/b]
Compassionate and fluffy, these kind companions are said to bless the dreams of those they trust.
They'll also keep your farm animals company!

The player has full control over what familiar(s) follow them outside the farm by constructing the Familiar Den at Robins.

[b][i][u][size=5]Future Plans:[/size][/u][/i][/b]
I’ve loved working on this project and plan to keep expanding it! Planned updates include:

Even more familiars![/center]
[center]A second expansion mod, where Yuzuki gets her own shop! 
Additional events and dialogue!
a... THIRD NPC??? … [i](eventually)[/i]


[b][i][u]Final Notes:[/u][/i][/b]
Thank you so much for checking out my mod!
This is my first attempt at Stardew modding, and the community has been an incredible resource for learning how the game works under the hood.
I hope to keep improving this project with your feedback!
If even one person enjoys playing with Vael, Yuzuki, and their familiars, I’ll consider this a success.
Do keep in mind, I'm still new at all this - there may very well be bugs, just report em and I'll do what I can! <3[/center]
